name: simp
blurb: Mocking slang for someone who tries too hard to please a person they like
title: Simp Meaning: What Does Simp Mean in Slang?
description: Simp is mocking slang for someone who does too much for a person they like, hoping to win them over. Also a joke for adoring a celebrity. Origin, tone.
answer: A simp is someone who tries too hard to please a person they are attracted to, giving too much attention, money or favours in the hope of winning them over. It is usually aimed at men and is mostly an insult or a tease. As a verb, to "simp for" someone also has a lighter sense: to openly adore a celebrity or fictional character. The slang came out of hip-hop in the late 1980s and went viral on TikTok around 2019 and 2020.

body: Simp has long been short for simpleton, a fool, recorded from the early 1900s. The modern slang appears to come from Black hip-hop slang: lyrics from the late 1980s and the 1990s already used simp for a man seen as too eager to please a woman. Dictionary.com says it spread online in the 2010s and hit the mainstream with a viral TikTok trend in late 2019.
A popular claim online says simp is an acronym. Dictionary.com points out the word is much older than that story.

ul: "He drove two hours to bring her soup and she left him on read. Simp." (mocking)
"I'm not a simp, I'm just nice."
"I will simp for this character until the day I die." (playful, fan use)
"Stop simping and text your friends back."

body: Calling someone a simp mocks normal kindness, like buying dinner or comforting a partner, as weakness, and it is often used to shame men for caring. Joking "I simp for this singer" about yourself is harmless. Avoid it as a label for a friend's real relationship.

faq.a: Usually, yes. Aimed at someone it mocks them as desperate or overeager. Used about yourself and a celebrity, it is a joke.
To go out of your way for, or openly adore, someone, from a crush to a fictional character.
No. The popular acronym explanation is a later invention; the word goes back to simpleton and late-1980s hip-hop slang.
